intro.summary: St. Louise de Marillac, co-founder of the Daughters of Charity with St. Vincent de Paul, served the poor and helped organize Catholic charitable works in France.

blocks.text: You can pray the full St. Louise de Marillac Novena below.
blocks.title: Introduction

blocks.notes: expanded canonical prayer references into full rosary texts; Added a few paragraph breaks for clearer pacing while keeping all prayer text unchanged.; converted "mention request here" into a personal-intention pause marker; converted intention marker into sacred bell and personal-intention pause

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. May we, like St. Louise, seek God’s will with trusting hearts. St. Louise, from your youth you longed to serve our Heavenly Father and those around you. I pray that we, too, may be compelled to mirror your steadfast devotion to Our Lord through our love and service to our families, neighbors, and communities. St. Louise, you faithfully embraced the earthly roles of daughter, student, wife, mother, widow, religious, and co-foundress of the Daughters of Charity. May your example ignite within us a deeper love of Christ and inspire us to serve others with humility, compassion, and charity. Devout Daughter of Charity, pray for us.

Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Amen. In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
